title: skills(objectstack-ui): teach dataset member synonyms and description (ADR-0149 D1)
body:
domain:spec#2 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jUe9c6YdtNkrzUnMUd

Filing gate: ④ a per-layer child of a coordination card: the `skills/**` half of #31587 (ADR-0149 D7 card 1), the `domain:skills` child triage named in 6724017037 (#31424 rule 5). Filed by the spec seat because PR #31652's `Skills-docs:` line owes a card number before ACCEPT. This card carries the skills teaching; #31587 keeps the spec keys.

Blocked-by: #31587

- **Business reason:** an AI writing a `*.dataset.ts` today is taught that a measure or dimension has no `description` (the retired `guidance.description` prescription). Once PR #31652 lands, members accept `synonyms` and a business-definition `description`, which the dataset AI tools (#31589) match and publish. Without the skill page, AI authors never write them, so the ADR-0149 accuracy gain (D5) has nothing to measure.
- **Reader:** the `domain:skills` lane, after PR #31652 merges.
- **What to teach** (from the merged spec, not from this card): `synonyms` (match input, not translated, one list for every language, dataset-level uniqueness against names, labels and other synonyms) and member `description` (plain-language business definition, never a prompt, translatable under `datasets.<name>.{dimensions,measures}.<m>.description`). Likely pages: `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/dashboards.md` (dataset section) and the `datasets` line of `skills/objectstack-i18n/SKILL.md`; the dev measures where datasets are taught.
- **Dedupe (open and closed):** `dataset synonyms skills`, `dataset description skills`: 0 hits besides #31587.
